Cc: FinTrust Procurement <procure@fintrust.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2024 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Subprocessor inventory + export authorization for EdgeBeacon telemetry

Hi Markus,

We're preparing the security & privacy sign-off for the upcoming telemetry pilot and need an updated subprocessor roster and an explicit statement about cross-border exports. In particular:

- Is the new telemetry partner (EdgeBeacon) going to process any customer-identifiable logs or tenant IDs?
- Will telemetry ingestion or auxiliary processing ever route logs outside the EU (e.g., to the US) for indexing or enrichment?
- Please provide the current subprocessor inventory (vendor, country, data types, purpose) and any supporting evidence you can share (SOC2 report, encryption-in-transit screenshots).

Procurement would like to have a DPA addendum to cover the pilot and a DocuSign envelope we can sign. Can you send the roster + proposed addendum and any minimum export/crypto statements by end of day Monday?

Thanks,
Liam O'Connell
Senior Security PM, FinTrust
liam.oconnell@fintrust.com

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads up.

Kimberly, Marissa — can you pull the latest inventory and a concise summary of export controls for EdgeBeacon? Key asks from FinTrust below; prioritize:

- Jurisdictional routing during ingestion, enrichment, and long-term storage.
- Any enclave/onshore fallback we can commit to in the DPA addendum.

Liam — we'll aim to get an initial packet to you by Monday EOD. If Procurement needs an expedited DocuSign flow earlier, flag here and we'll push.

Hi all — attaching the current subprocessor inventory and draft addendum. See attachments: subprocessor_inventory_v2.xlsx, redwood_dpa_addendum_v1.pdf, evidence_snapshot.zip.

Summary highlights (brief):
- EdgeBeacon (edgebeacon.io) — Purpose: telemetry ingestion & index enrichment. Processing locations: EU (primary), with optional US enrichment for advanced indexing.
- Data types: service-level telemetry, request/response metadata, error stacks; tenant IDs are present in a hashed form by default. Plaintext tenant identifiers are not included in telemetry pipelines unless a customer explicitly enables metadata passthrough.
- Export behavior: by default, telemetry is processed in-region (EU). We have a routing policy that can forward to US-only enrichers; this is off for EU customers unless explicitly requested and documented in a change control.
- Crypto & transit: TLS 1.2+ with TLS_ECDHE_RSA_* ciphers, TLS mutual auth for internal links, and service-to-service traffic encrypted. Keys are managed in our KMS; EdgeBeacon uses customer-tenant-scoped keys when requested.

Requested actions for FinTrust review:
1) Confirm whether hashed tenant IDs meet your pseudonymization requirements or if you require removal.
2) If FinTrust requires a hard onshore fallback (all EU telemetry processed and stored only in EU), we can add a contractual commitment in the DPA addendum but it requires feature flagging on our routing layer and a 3-week lead time.
3) We included a stub DocuSign link in the addendum document (page 3 header). If Procurement wants a standalone envelope, we can generate it.

Quoted for context:
> On Fri, Mar 15, 2024 at 09:12 AM Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@fintrust.com> wrote:

Let me know if you want additional evidence (SOC2 AICPA report) — we can provide an access link or redacted snapshot.

Thanks,

Kimberly — thanks, this is helpful. A couple of clarifying questions before we route to legal/procurement for countersign:

- You said tenant IDs are hashed by default. Can you confirm the hashing algorithm and whether salts are per-tenant? Our privacy team will need to ensure that hashed values are non-reversible.
- For the optional US enrichment path: please confirm whether any downstream processors in the US will persist identifiable fields and whether they perform de-anonymization. If so, that would be a blocker without stronger contractual guarantees.
- If you can provide a short statement we can attach to the DPA addendum that "Redwood will not persist plaintext tenant identifiers in non-EU jurisdictions for FinTrust data without explicit instruction", that would speed approval.

Procurement — looping you in to confirm preferred DocuSign flow.

Cheers,
Liam

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@fintrust.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, FinTrust Procurement <procure@fintrust.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Mar 2024 15:33:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Subprocessor inventory + export authorization for EdgeBeacon telemetry

Hi Liam — quick follow-up with the items you requested and next steps.

1) Hashing: we use salted SHA-256 hashing; salts are rotated per-tenant and stored separately from the telemetry indices. We treat salts as KMS-protected configuration and rotate on a quarterly cadence. This is documented in the evidence snapshot (see /crypto.md inside the zip).

2) US enrichment path: EdgeBeacon's enrichment service performs metadata tagging and stores only hashed tenant references by default. No downstream partner performs de-anonymization for FinTrust data unless explicitly contracted and authorized. We will add the following sentence to the DPA addendum under Section 4.2 (Data Transfers):

"Redwood Inference will not persist plaintext tenant identifiers in non-EU jurisdictions for FinTrust data without explicit written instruction from an authorized FinTrust representative."

3) DocuSign: created a DocuSign envelope for the DPA addendum and original statement — signing link below. Envelope is pre-populated with the PDF attachment (redwood_dpa_addendum_v1.pdf).

DocuSign signing link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=ABC123DEF

Please review and if Procurement confirms the flow, we'll mark the envelope as required by end of day Monday and provide a countersigned copy once returned.

Attachments sent to Procurement team: subprocessor_inventory_v2.xlsx, redwood_dpa_addendum_v1.pdf, evidence_snapshot.zip

If you want a stronger onshore-only SLA in the contract rather than the feature-flaged routing commitment, let us know and we can provide a proposal and timeline (estimate: 3 weeks of engineering work + change control).

Thanks — will follow up once we have the countersigned copy.

Best regards,
Markus Klein
